policy.statement: These sources inform independently expressed OE direction rules. They do not select a runtime, govern OE, or override locked editorial, evidence, design, or production contracts.
policy.copyPolicy: No upstream code, templates, or prose are copied into the OE skills package. Repository-specific tools, provider syntax, and universalized dramatic defaults are excluded.

adoptedPrinciples: Plan concrete visual slots against the narration rather than collecting generic coverage.
Treat editing as narrative selection: choose the strongest usable sub-window and cut before an action exhausts itself.
Keep transition vocabulary small and use it only when continuity has a real carrier.
excludedPrinciples: OpenMontage's runtime, provider, agent-orchestration, and toolchain choices.
Wholesale reuse of AGPL code, templates, or prose.
Decorative transitions or automated scoring as substitutes for human narrative judgement.

adoptedPrinciples: Give every shot a narrative job and express feeling through observable action, gaze, geometry, objects, and environmental pressure.
Motivate camera movement with an event or information change.
Direct toward a concrete final image rather than a stack of aesthetic adjectives.
excludedPrinciples: A fixed dramatic formula or escalation curve for every OE documentary passage.
Provider-specific prompt syntax, model selection, dialogue, sound, or music defaults.
Stylistic flourish that conflicts with Boundary Ledger restraint or evidence discipline.

adoptedPrinciples: Separate locked continuity from the one changing beat in a generated prompt.
Translate internal emotion into physical blocking, micro-action, and stillness that a camera can record.
Keep voiceover out of the generated performance and preserve explicit spatial positions.
excludedPrinciples: Universal two-to-three-second timing, provider assumptions, or a required end-to-end character pipeline.
Dialogue-first coverage imposed without considering the scene context and actual soundtrack.
Any supplied template as an OE production contract.

adoptedPrinciples: Lock scene geography and a master before deriving closer setups.
Preserve the action line, screen direction, eyelines, and stable character positions across generated clips.
Use one primary action per clip and assemble and trim before color and sound polish.
Choose coverage and cut timing for the dramatic or informational turn; hold when the performance needs uninterrupted time.
excludedPrinciples: Five-setup dialogue coverage as the default for narration-led OE scenes.
Dialogue, NLE, audio, camera, or timing values as universal OE requirements.
Coverage that depends on unavailable words for essential meaning; explicit narrated dramatization may use conversational coverage without claiming verbatim or synchronized speech.
